title: Polling decision v1
description: config/validation/polling/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F8b): the decision on one candidate of the polling scan (a sleep inside a loop, VAL-events-no-polling), keyed by file and enclosing function so it survives line moves. backoff, dormant, test-infra and measurement are not polling; state-wait is a real wait on a state on an interval and stays counted until an event replaces it.

replace_with.description: For a state-wait: the event that would replace it.
